message.content:
{
  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Your medicines",
      "bullets": [
        {
          "id": "b1",
          "text": "Oxycodone 5 mg, take by mouth every 4 hours only when you need it for pain. Do not drive while taking. This is a strong pain medicine used when other pain treatments do not work well enough.",
          "sources": ["p1:L6", "drug:oxycodone", "term:PO", "term:q4h", "term:PRN"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b2",
          "text": "Tylenol 1,000 mg, take by mouth every 8 hours on a schedule for 2 weeks. This medicine helps relieve minor aches, pains, and fever.",
          "sources": ["p1:L7", "drug:acetaminophen", "term:PO", "term:q8h"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b3",
          "text": "Enoxaparin 40 mg, give a shot just under the skin once daily for 14 days for blood clot prevention. This is a blood thinner used to prevent or treat blood clots.",
          "sources": ["p1:L8", "drug:enoxaparin", "term:subQ"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b4",
          "text": "Docusate 100 mg, take by mouth two times a day while taking oxycodone. This is a stool softener that helps relieve occasional constipation.",
          "sources": ["p1:L9", "drug:docusate", "term:PO", "term:BID"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b5",
          "text": "Ondansetron 4 mg, take by mouth every 8 hours only when you need it for nausea. This medicine prevents nausea and vomiting from chemotherapy, radiation, or surgery.",
          "sources": ["p1:L10", "drug:ondansetron", "term:PO", "term:q8h", "term:PRN"]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "med_schedule": [
    {
      "drug": "Oxycodone",
      "dose": "5 mg",
      "morning": false,
      "midday": false,
      "evening": false,
      "night": false,
      "as_needed": true,
      "note": "Take every 4 hours only when needed for pain. Do not drive while taking.",
      "sources": ["p1:L6"]
    },
    {
      "drug": "Tylenol",
      "dose": "1,000 mg",
      "morning": true,
      "midday": true,
      "evening": true,
      "night": false,
      "as_needed": false,
      "note": "Scheduled for 2 weeks.",
      "sources": ["p1:L7"]
    },
    {
      "drug": "Enoxaparin",
      "dose": "40 mg",
      "morning": true,
      "midday": false,
      "evening": false,
      "night": false,
      "as_needed": false,
      "note": "Give as a shot under the skin once daily for 14 days.",
      "sources": ["p1:L8"]
    },
    {
      "drug": "Docusate",
      "dose": "100 mg",
      "morning": true,
      "midday": false,
      "evening": false,
      "night": true,
      "as_needed": false,
      "note": "Take while taking oxycodone.",
      "sources": ["p1:L9"]
    },
    {
      "drug": "Ondansetron",
      "dose": "4 mg",
      "morning": false,
      "midday": false,
      "evening": false,
      "night": false,
      "as_needed": true,
      "note": "Take every 8 hours only when needed for nausea.",
      "sources": ["p1:L10"]
    }
  ],

}
